{{Quote|You&hellip; can sense him?|Naa'leth to Asajj Ventress, referring to Count Dooku|<ref name="nightsisters" />}}
'''Naa'leth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="nightsisters" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Karis and Naa'leth are the greatest warriors of our coven.|[[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="nightsisters" />}}
[[File:VentressStrikeTeam-FFp48.png|thumb|left|220px|Karis, alongside Naa'leth and Ventress attempted to assassinate Dooku.]]
Naa'leth, along with fellow sister [[Karis/Legends|Karis]], was recognized by her leader [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] as one of the greatest warriors of her clan. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], she and other [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] defended their clan's village against the approach of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], whom she and the others interpreted as an unwelcome stranger, unaware that she was in fact one of their clan. She soon became involved in the [[Mission to Serenno (Nightsisters)/Legends|revenge]] of Ventress on [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]&mdash;Naa'leth, Karis and Ventress&mdash;initially gained the upper hand, but were overpowered by Dooku and forced to retreat.<ref name="nightsisters" />

Naa'leth briefly accompanied fellow sisters Talzin and [[Talia (Nightsister)/Legends|Talia]] to Serenno on a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in order to deliver [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] to Count Dooku&mdash;a seemingly innocent gesture which in fact was part of a greater revenge scheme. The three Nightsisters returned to Dathomir shortly afterward.<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref>

Naa'leth was later killed during the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]].<ref name="Massacre" />

==Powers and abilities==
Naa'leth was hard to detect due to the spells cast upon her by Mother Talzin. Her weapons included a captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], a [[Nightsister dagger|dagger]], and an [[Nightsister energy bow/Legends|energy bow]]. She also moved silently and had [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-enhanced reflexes.<ref name="CloneCard" />

In combat, she was known to use the "Coiled Viper" dagger strike.<ref name="TCW H2H" />
